images.image_prompt:
Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, vertical 4:5, mobile-thumbnail-readable. A dominant protagonist, an attractive adult Korean Shorthair orange-and-white cheese-tabby cat with a natural, balanced, sturdy build; bright warm cheese-orange short fur with realistic darker orange tabby stripes; large natural upright ears; a broad clean white blaze running from the forehead down between the eyes toward the pink nose; clean white fur around the mouth and muzzle, on the chin, continuing naturally down the entire neck, chest and belly; all four paws and lower feet covered in clean white fur like four neat white boots, with the white fur rising naturally from the toes and clearly visible whenever the paws are shown; a distinctive small congenital orange cheese-tabby fur marking around parts of the mouth area, naturally integrated into the otherwise white muzzle, explicitly a permanent fur pattern and never food, dirt or staining; round amber-brown eyes; pink nose; short dense realistic fur; natural whiskers; slightly rounded cheeks; realistic memorable face. In a flooded museum grand hall inside a Time-machine laboratory, an armored billionaire-tech defender hero in bright, clearly separated suit colors plants a giant bracing stance against a leaning tower while a red theatrical countdown light flashes. The tower bends like a spring in safe VFX, water ripples, and a skyscraper canyon frame of towering gallery structures surrounds the cat. Outcome: the collapsed debris clears into a golden sunrise stage, visibly different from the rescue. Include Leaning tower rescue, collapsing set becomes a sunrise stage, tongue sweeping across the nose, giant bracing stance, skyscraper canyon frame, and one decisive action.
